
                    AN ACT UPDATING THE LINKAGE EXACTION PROGRAM IN THE CITY OF MEDFORD 
                

                    Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives in General Court assembled, and by the authority of the same, as follows:
Subsection (B) of section 2 of chapter 488 of the acts of 1989 is hereby amended by striking out clause (5) and inserting in place thereof the follow clause:-           (5) The level of any exaction shall be reviewed not less than every 10 years and reset as required based upon the recommendation of the office of community development and the mayor of the city. In between reviews, updates to any exaction may be adjusted, over time, based on changes in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers compiled by the United States Bureau of Labor Statistics.
Approved, November 10, 2025.
